blocks.content:
Calibration turns your monitoring intent into durable checks that later unattended runs can evaluate. Assistant inspects relevant infrastructure, dashboards, alert rules, and live telemetry, then saves validated queries and a calibration baseline.

During calibration, Assistant asks clarifying questions and shows proposed checks. It can create PromQL, LogQL, BigQuery SQL, and Grafana-managed alert checks. Calibration must save at least one enabled, validated query before the watcher can start.

blocks.content: To calibrate, complete the following steps:

Open the **New watcher** form.

Do this if you left the form after the previous milestone.
blocks.hint: Skip if you are already on the form. If you cancelled, click **New watcher** then **Set up manually** instead.
Skip if you don't want a persistent watcher in this stack. **Calibrate** stays disabled until **Name**, **Give the watcher context**, and **Datasources** are filled.

blocks.content: Answer Assistant's clarifying questions and review the proposed checks before they're saved.
When calibration finishes, review the generated checks, thresholds, and coverage gaps on the detail page before you start scheduled runs.
Calibration saved checks and a baseline, or you skipped it. In the next milestone, you'll start scheduled runs and trigger **Run now**.
